description: Seven builder stories: OpenAI's Agents API beta and GPT-Live-1 voice layer, Images 2.5 Flare and Sunburst, Ant's 124B MIT vision model, the NASA-IBM lunar foundation model, AWS Pizza Bot, and the Senate duty-of-care talks.
lead: Agent infrastructure dominated the last 24 hours, with open weights close behind. OpenAI opened its Codex harness as the Agents API, shipped a full-duplex voice layer, and split image generation into speed and precision models, while Ant released 124B-parameter open vision weights and IBM with NASA opened a lunar mapping model. Plus an open-source inbox for background agents and Senate talks on a duty of care for frontier models. Every summary is in our own words; follow the links for the original reporting.
title: AI news digest — September 12, 2026: agent APIs, open vision models, and lunar mapping
